items.title: Remote Code Execution via Template Engine Injection
items.summary: A critical vulnerability in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source allows unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution through a template engine injection.

items.title: Security Update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This security bulletin addresses multiple high-severity vulnerabilities including Incorrect Authorization (CVE-2026-92909) and Stored Cross-site Scripting (CVE-2026-91013, CVE-2026-100133, CVE-2026-92911) that could lead to privilege escalation or arbitrary code execution.

items.title: Remote Code Execution (0-day) via Template System Injection
items.summary: A critical zero-day vulnerability in Magento and Adobe Commerce allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code by injecting malicious code into Magento's template system. This vulnerability was actively exploited in the wild.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization leading to Privilege Escalation
items.summary: A critical incorrect authorization vulnerability in Adobe Commerce allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to switch a customer session to another customer account and escalate privileges. Indications emerged that threat actors were attempting to exploit this vulnerability in the wild.

items.title: Security Update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This security update resolves several high-severity vulnerabilities, including Stored Cross-site Scripting (CVE-2026-48414, CVE-2026-48413) and Incorrect Authorization (CVE-2026-48415, CVE-2026-48416), which could lead to arbitrary code execution or security feature bypass.

items.title: Multiple Critical Vulnerabilities in Amasty Magento Extensions
items.summary: Amasty released a security update for dozens of its Magento extensions, addressing six critical vulnerabilities that could lead to remote code execution, account takeover, admin login bypass, and payment fraud.

items.title: Unauthenticated Arbitrary File Upload in Amasty Order Attributes
items.summary: An unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in Amasty Order Attributes allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, potentially leading to remote code execution.

items.title: Unrestricted File Upload via REST API
items.summary: PolyShell allows attackers to upload executable files to any Magento or Adobe Commerce store via the REST API, with Sansec observing attacks on a significant percentage of stores. No official patch was available at the time of the report.
